sections.title: Introduction
sections.text:
Haunted Mines is a 2-lane Map belonging to the Nexus universe.
The signature Objective of this Map is an Undead Army dropping Cursed Skulls.
The team who collects more Cursed Skulls will get a stronger Grave Golem,
the other team will get a weaker one.

sections.title: Draft Strategy
sections.text:
Prefer
Siege damage for Structures
Sustain damage/healing
Effects relying on impassable terrain
Heroes for clearing Mercenary Camps
Point control for Sapper Camps
Moderate waveclear
Avoid
Quests to stack on Heroes
Weak early game
See our Haunted Mines Tier List page for further information »

sections.title: Lane Assignments
sections.text:
Here you can find one or more formations
that are viable on this Map. Keep in mind that positions in lane
are not strict and will often change based on the situation.

sections.title: Formation 1-4
Map Strategy
sections.text:
At 0:30 minutes or whenever available, start clearing the Sapper Camp
in the lane your 4-man is and capture it as soon as possible. Watch out for invades!
If your team does not have point control tools,
go for the farthest Sapper Camp from the enemy 4-man.
At 2:20 minutes or 20-30 seconds before the Undead Army spawns in the Mines,
start clearing the allied Siege Camp and capture it slightly before the Undead Army
appears in the Mines. To make this Mercenary Camp join the lane behind allied Minions,
capture it at 2:40 minutes or 10 seconds after a wave of Minions spawned.
At 3:00 minutes and whenever the Undead Army spawns in the Mines,
each team should decide how many Heroes to send
inside the Mines depending on how much siege damage they have.
If it is early game,
the Offlaner can keep soaking.
If you decide to play for the Objective, you should collect as many Cursed Skulls
as possible from Risen Miners without going too far from the rest of your team. Then,
if your team has an advantage, attack the Grave Golem.
Otherwise, you can just leave the Mines and push a lane.
If your team collected a lot more Cursed Skulls than the enemy team, your 4-man
should push together with the allied Grave Golem.
If it is early game,
the Offlaner can keep soaking.
If the enemy team collected a lot more Cursed Skulls than your team,
your 4-man should defend allied Structures from the enemy Grave Golem.
If it is early game,
the Offlaner can keep soaking.
If each team collected about the same amount of Cursed Skulls,
the team with more siege damage should push
and the other team should defend.
If it is early game,
the Offlaner can keep soaking.

sections.title: Mercenary Camps
Siege Camp
sections.text:
This type of Mercenary Camp features 2 Siege Giants. Once captured,
it spawns the same units fighting for your team in the corresponding lane.
When possible, push with them to get more value.
Spawn Time
Respawn Delay
0:30 minutes
3:00 minutes after its last capture
Baseline Experience
Experience Scaling
280 Experience
+4 Experience per minute (*)
(*) For this Mercenary Camp, Experience starts scaling after 1 minute.
Instead of attacking enemies with Basic Attacks, Siege Giants throw stones at them.
These stones can be dodged, so it is possible to capture them without taking any damage.
Once captured, they are capable of damaging enemy Structures without getting in their range.
Siege Giants deal 100% bonus damage to Structures.

sections.title: Sapper Camp
sections.text:
This type of Mercenary Camp features 3 Sappers. Once captured,
it spawns the same units fighting for your team in the corresponding lane.
When possible, push with them to get more value.
Spawn Time
Respawn Delay
0:30 minutes
2:30 minutes after its last capture
Baseline Experience
Experience Scaling
90 Experience
+6 Experience per minute (*)
(*) For this Mercenary Camp, Experience starts scaling after 1 minute.
When in range of an enemy Structure, Sappers will sprint at it and explode.
All enemy non-Heroes within 2.5 range will take damage form it. Structures will take
1750 damage (not scaling) and non-Structures will take 187 damage (not scaling).
You can briefly interrupt the explosion by using
Stun, Silence, or even
Knockback effects. That said, if you do
not kill them in time, they will try again immediately after.

sections.title: Watch Towers
sections.text:
Haunted Mines features 2 Watch Towers:
they are located in the middle area, one near the left entrance
to the Mines and another one near the right entrance to the Mines.
If a team controls a Watch Tower, entering in the Mines from the
corresponding entrance becomes more dangerous as the enemy team
could see you walk outside and quickly prepare a trap inside.

Securing a Watch Tower provides your team with greater vision,
allowing you to keep an eye on enemy movements in that part of the battlefield.
Watch Towers can be captured by standing in the area until your team gains control.
After 45 seconds of not being occupied, they become neutral again. Because of this,
they should only be captured when you are playing in that area for other reasons
(either to capture Mercenary Camps or for contesting the Objective).
Watch Towers controlled by the enemy team are extremely dangerous,
especially when there are bushes nearby. Therefore, you should think twice
before contesting them. If you do not have mobility tools at your disposal
and your teammates are not nearby to help you, you should definitely not try
to capture a Watch Tower as you will only risk dying for no reason.
Staying alive is more important than getting vision.

sections.title: Map Objective
sections.text:
The signature objective of Haunted Mines consists of an Undead Army
composed of 8 groups of Risen Miners and 1 Grave Golem who drop Cursed Skulls.
When active, each team has to collect 55 Cursed Skulls. Once a team does that,
each team is rewarded with a laning Grave Golem. Their power is increased
by the amount of Cursed Skulls collected by the corresponding team.
Spawn Time
Respawn Delay
3:00
2:00 minutes after the laning Grave Golems die

Venture Underground
The Haunted Mines will periodically open with an Undead Army underneath.
Collect the Skulls
Destroy the Undead and collect their Skulls to power your Golems!
Unleash the Golems
After a team has collected 55 Skulls, the Golems will arise for both teams! The more Skulls your team collects, the stronger your Golem!

sections.title: Mines
sections.text:
To enter or leave the Mines, you need to interact with one of the 4 Mine Shafts
or issue a movement command on the other section of the battlefield.

The entrances are located in the following places:
1 entrance in the middle of the top lane;
1 entrance near the Watch Tower on the right;
1 entrance near the Watch Tower on the left;
1 entrance in the middle of the bottom lane.
Hero vision is reduced from 12 to 6.5 while inside the Mines.
This means that you will not be able to see enemy Heroes
as usual and that some Abilities will basically have reduced
range unless there is an allied unit giving vision.
While inside the Mines, some Heroes can use the surrounding
impassable terrain at their
advantage—to Stun enemy Heroes,
to move faster, to block enemy Heroes, and/or to punish
enemy Heroes who tend to group.

The exits are located in the following places:
1 exit at the top of the underground area;
1 exit on the right of the underground area;
1 exit at the bottom of the underground area;
1 exit on the left of the underground area.
Be careful when using Mine Shafts to enter in or exit from the Mines.
If enemy Heroes control a Watch Tower, they will have vision
on the nearby Mine Shaft. This means they will be able to see who
is entering and who just left the Mines.

sections.title: Undead Army
Cursed Skulls
sections.text:
In the Mines there will always be 110 Cursed Skulls available for each Objective phase.
Collect 55 Cursed Skulls before the enemy team does to get a stronger laning Grave Golem.
Risen Miners drop 2 Cursed Skulls and are split into 8 groups of 4-5 Risen Miners.
As a consequence, each group of Risen Miners will drop from 8 to 10 Cursed Skulls.
The underground Grave Golem drops 8 Cursed Skulls for every 25% Health lost
and 6 Cursed Skulls upon death, for a total of 38 Cursed Skulls.

To give you an overview, Cursed Skulls are distributed as follows:
2 groups of 10 Cursed Skulls on the top-right;
2 groups of 8 Cursed Skulls on the bottom-right;
2 groups of 10 Cursed Skulls on the bottom-left;
2 groups of 8 Cursed Skulls on the top-left;
a total of 38 Cursed Skulls in the center.
If both teams are collecting Cursed Skulls, each team will get about 4 groups of Risen Miners,
which corresponds to at least 32 Cursed Skulls. This means that, in order to win the Objective,
you need to kill enemy Heroes either before they collect Cursed Skulls from the other 4 groups
of Risen Miners or to have numerical advantage for fighting the Grave Golem in the middle
of the Mines and bring him down to 25% Health for getting a total of 24 Cursed Skulls.

sections.title: Grave Golems
sections.text:
Once a team collects 55 Cursed Skulls, laning Grave Golems for each team will spawn in opposite
lanes at the same time, starting randomly and then alternating for the rest of the game.
You can see in which lanes they will spawn by looking at the glowing bones near the middle of each lane.
The allied Grave Golem will spawn in the lane with the glowing bones closer to your Core whereas
the enemy Grave Golem will spawn in the lane with the glowing bones further away from your Core.
The power of the laning Grave Golems increases with Game Time and based on Cursed Skulls collected by
the owners. The time-based scaling snapshots when both teams combined collect 60 Cursed Skulls.
If both teams combined collect less than 60 Cursed Skulls, however, the time-based scaling snapshots
when the Grave Golems spawn in lane. Once the time-based scaling has been applied, Cursed Skulls
collected by the owners further increase the power of the laning Grave Golems by 7% each.

sections.title: Core Ability
sections.text: Contrary to all other Battlegrounds, there is no Core Ability on Haunted Mines.

sections.title: Win Conditions
sections.text:
To win the game on Haunted Mines, you should count on
any of the following win conditions:
Map Objective.

sections.title: Tips and Tricks
sections.text:
Use the first Healing Fountain (2-minute cooldown) before 1:00 minute.
This is because the first Objective on this Map activates at 3:00 minutes,
so you will have it back in time for that.
Mines will open at 3:00 minutes into the game and never close again.
You can use them for confusing enemy Heroes while fighting near Mine Shafts, or
for moving across the battlefield without being seen from Watch Towers.
The groups of Risen Miners in the top-right and bottom-left of the Mines
drop 2 more Cursed Skulls than the others. If possible, collect them first.
Then, if they have not been killed yet, move to the nearest groups of Risen Miners.
If you move the camera to the center of the upper portion of the
battlefield, you will be able to take a peek into the center of the Mines.
This will allow you to see if enemy Heroes are fighting the Grave Golem.
The laning Grave Golem takes about 30 seconds to spawn. You can use this time
to capture the allied Siege Camp. This way, Siege Giants will damage the enemy Grave Golem
or support the allied Grave Golem, depending on which lane they are on.
Right before the laning Grave Golem spawns, you can try to
crowd control enemy Heroes near the spawning
location, so that they will get hit by his powerful Abilities.
See our Map Guides page for further information »
